statement: Two separate emulation implementations, joycontrol and nxbt, implement L, R and Pro type selector values 0x01, 0x02 and 0x03 for Nintendo-facing Bluetooth controller personalities. Their source agreement does not qualify physical retail bytes independently of existing dekuNukem/host-consumer lineage.

applicability.revision: joycontrol 18a09da1a04306534ff9e1df8a1a69c0192a3244 GPL-3.0; nxbt ec4b800ad6c55de96bb6c7f9f84b5bdc59a4c975 MIT; source-only
applicability.scope: Independent emulator implementation behavior at exact pins; no device capture or successful Switch host session verified.
